Package com.vectorpeaks.backend.service

Class MaintenanceService

java.lang.Object
com.vectorpeaks.backend.service.MaintenanceService
@Service public class MaintenanceService extends Object
Service managing the maintenance mode state. Stores state in memory (lost on restart – suitable for single-instance deployments).

When activated, a 20-minute countdown begins. During this period, non-admin clients should display a warning banner. After the countdown expires, maintenance is considered fully active.
